categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
